tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch12:12-3↗ ex:open-mobius-band Show that every compact 2-dimensional Euclidean space form is diffeomorphic to the torus or the Klein bottle, and every noncompact one is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb {R}^2$, $\mathbb {S}^1 \times \mathbb {R}^2$, or the open Möbius band (see Example 2.35). \end{exercise}
